system.description:
This is where pure, raw strength begins — a vampire at this pinnacle can level buildings with her hands alone, and nothing may stand in her way.

Spend three Blood Traits to gain monumental strength for the rest of the scene: your unarmed strikes inflict three additional levels of lethal damage, and improvised heavy weapons (a telephone pole, a chunk of concrete, a car) grant six bonus Traits to bid and two additional levels of lethal damage. You can punch through hulls or tear cars apart, subject to Static Physical Challenges at the Storyteller's discretion, and any solid hit against a mortal or ghoul kills instantly unless the blow is deliberately pulled.
